articles.title: Talk is growing of a Tesla-SpaceX merger. Will geopolitics throw a spanner in the works?
articles.summary: Discussions are intensifying around a potential merger between Tesla and SpaceX, which could revolutionize the electric vehicle and aerospace industries, but geopolitical tensions may pose significant challenges to this ambitious union. This merger could not only streamline production and innovation but also reshape global markets, making it a pivotal moment in tech history.

articles.title: What Sputnik couldn’t do to American science, Beijing has
articles.summary: The U.S. government's strategic investments in key technology firms, including a significant stake in Intel and partnerships with Nvidia and AMD, signal a dramatic shift towards state-directed capitalism in the tech sector, challenging decades of free-market principles and reshaping the global competitive landscape. This move not only enhances America's technological sovereignty but also positions it to better counter China's growing influence in critical industries.

articles.title: Upend the trickle-down
articles.summary:
• Neoliberalism has eroded democratic institutions, leading to a concentration of power among a wealthy elite.  
• The trickle-down economic theory has failed to deliver on its promises, exacerbating inequality and social discontent.  
• Understanding the mechanisms of oligarchy reveals pathways to reclaim democracy and redistribute power.  
• A systemic overhaul is necessary to dismantle entrenched interests and restore accountability in governance.  
• True progress hinges on reimagining economic structures that prioritize collective well-being over individual wealth accumulation.

articles.title: US-China AI agreement, G20 trade spat, inflation data
articles.summary: The recent agreement among the United States, China, and other G20 nations to implement light-touch regulation for artificial intelligence marks a significant breakthrough in international tech diplomacy, potentially paving the way for enhanced collaboration and innovation in a field often marred by rivalry. This consensus not only fosters a more stable regulatory environment but also sets the stage for future discussions that could reshape the global AI landscape.
